name: clip-1
case: plain demo of one screen: a visitor reads the public demo, with nothing missing
script: This is the SLEUTH API running on my laptop in fixture mode.
First I list the projects a visitor can see.
The only project is the public ProofPay demo.
Next I open the demo and read its script and checklist.
Then I list the evidence the analysis found for each line.
Now I list the findings that still need a person.
The coverage summary shows which checklist items are covered.
Finally I download the report as a CSV file.
